decision.reason: Four exact selected-pair values were recorded in hash-verified API301 responses before cutoff, all on 2026-09-05: two values are 1.0 and two are 9999.9. The 1.0 values have negative conditional display-price proxies because both frozen probabilities are below 1.0; neither passes any fixed EV threshold. The 9999.9 values are unusual and excluded from EV because their official meaning and bettability are unverified. None of the four is counted as a verified public executable quote because the collector clock and bettable display were not independently established.
